paragraphs.source_en: The moment Ishikawa Kazumasa returned to Okazaki Castle, he shut himself in his room. He sat quietly at his desk and picked up the brush resting on the inkstone, while the faces of Tokugawa Ieyasu and Toyotomi Hideyoshi rose before his eyes. He loosened the brush tip between his teeth, dipped it in ink, and first wrote the five characters “Military Intelligence of the Tokugawa Clan” on a blank sheet.
